versos.grego: Μὴ κρίνετε, ἵνα μὴ κριθῆτε·

controles.web: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
controles.kjv: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
controles.livre: Não julgueis, para que não sejais julgados.

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ γὰρ κρίματι κρίνετε κριθήσεσθε, καὶ ἐν ᾧ μέτρῳ μετρεῖτε μετρηθήσεται ὑμῖν.

controles.web: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
controles.kjv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
controles.livre: Porque com o juízo que julgardes sereis julgados; e com a medida que medirdes vos medirão.

versos.grego: τί δὲ βλέπεις τὸ κάρφος τὸ ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου, τὴν δὲ ἐν τῷ σῷ ὀφθαλμῷ δοκὸν οὐ κατανοεῖς;

controles.web: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
controles.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
controles.livre: Ora, por que vês o cisco que está no olho de teu irmão e não enxergas a trave que está em teu próprio olho?

versos.grego: ἢ πῶς ἐρεῖς τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου· Ἄφες ἐκβάλω τὸ κάρφος ἐκ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ σου, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ δοκὸς ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ σοῦ;

controles.web: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye;’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
controles.kjv: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
controles.livre: Ou como dirás a teu irmão: “Deixa-me tirar o cisco do teu olho”, se eis que há uma trave em teu próprio olho?

versos.grego: ὑποκριτά, ἔκβαλε πρῶτον ἐκ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ σοῦ τὴν δοκόν, καὶ τότε διαβλέψεις ἐκβαλεῖν τὸ κάρφος ἐκ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου.

controles.web: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.
controles.kjv: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye.
controles.livre: Hipócrita! Tira primeiro a trave do teu olho, e então verás claramente para tirar o cisco do olho de teu irmão.

versos.grego: Μὴ δῶτε τὸ ἅγιον τοῖς κυσίν, μηδὲ βάλητε τοὺς μαργαρίτας ὑμῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν χοίρων, μή ποτε καταπατήσουσιν αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτῶν καὶ στραφέντες ῥήξωσιν ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
controles.kjv: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
controles.livre: Não deis o que é santo aos cães, nem lanceis vossas pérolas diante dos porcos, para não acontecer de as pisarem com os pés e, virando-se, vos despedacem.

versos.grego: Αἰτεῖτε, καὶ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν· ζητεῖτε, καὶ εὑρήσετε· κρούετε, καὶ ἀνοιγήσεται ὑμῖν.

controles.web: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
controles.kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
controles.livre: Pedi, e vos será dado; buscai, e achareis; batei, e vos será aberto;

versos.grego: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ αἰτῶν λαμβάνει καὶ ὁ ζητῶν εὑρίσκει καὶ τῷ κρούοντι ἀνοιγήσεται.

controles.web: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
controles.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
controles.livre: Pois qualquer um que pede recebe; e quem busca acha; e ao que bate lhe é aberto.

versos.grego: ἢ τίς ἐστιν ἐξ ὑμῶν ἄνθρωπος, ὃν αἰτήσει ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἄρτον, μὴ λίθον ἐπιδώσει αὐτῷ;

controles.web: Or who is there among you, who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
controles.kjv: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
controles.livre: E quem há dentre vós que, se seu filho pedir pão, lhe dará uma pedra?

versos.grego: ἢ καὶ ἰχθὺν αἰτήσει, μὴ ὄφιν ἐπιδώσει αὐτῷ;

controles.web: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
controles.kjv: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
controles.livre: E se pedir peixe, lhe dará uma serpente?

versos.grego: εἰ οὖν ὑμεῖς πονηροὶ ὄντες οἴδατε δόματα ἀγαθὰ διδόναι τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν, πόσῳ μᾶλλον ὁ Πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς δώσει ἀγαθὰ τοῖς αἰτοῦσιν αὐτόν.

controles.web: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
controles.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
controles.livre: Ora, se vós, ainda que sejais maus, sabeis dar bons presentes a vossos filhos, quanto mais o vosso Pai, que está nos céus, dará coisas boas aos que lhe pedirem!

versos.grego: Πάντα οὖν ὅσα ἐὰν θέλητε ἵνα ποιῶσιν ὑμῖν οἱ ἄνθρωποι, οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε αὐτοῖς· οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ νόμος καὶ οἱ προφῆται.

controles.web: Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
controles.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
controles.livre: Portanto tudo o que quiserdes que os outros vos façam, fazei-lhes vós também assim; porque esta é a Lei e os Profetas.

versos.grego: Εἰσέλθατε διὰ τῆς στενῆς πύλης· ὅτι πλατεῖα ἡ πύλη καὶ εὐρύχωρος ἡ ὁδὸς ἡ ἀπάγουσα εἰς τὴν ἀπώλειαν, καὶ πολλοί εἰσιν οἱ εἰσερχόμενοι δι’ αὐτῆς·

controles.web: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those who enter in by it.
controles.kjv: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
controles.livre: Entrai pela porta estreita; porque larga é a porta, e espaçoso o caminho que leva à perdição; e muitos são os que por ela entram.

versos.grego: ὅτι στενὴ ἡ πύλη καὶ τεθλιμμένη ἡ ὁδὸς ἡ ἀπάγουσα εἰς τὴν ζωήν, καὶ ὀλίγοι εἰσὶν οἱ εὑρίσκοντες αὐτήν.

controles.web: Hownarrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.
controles.kjv: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
controles.livre: Porque estreita é a porta, e apertado o caminho que leva à vida; e são poucos os que a acham.

versos.grego: Προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν ψευδοπροφητῶν, οἵτινες ἔρχονται πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν ἐνδύμασιν προβάτων ἔσωθεν δέ εἰσιν λύκοι ἅρπαγες.

controles.web: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
controles.kjv: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
controles.livre: Tende cuidado, com os falsos profetas, que vêm a vós com roupa de ovelhas, mas por dentro são lobos vorazes.

versos.grego: ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν αὐτῶν ἐπιγνώσεσθε αὐτούς. μήτι συλλέγουσιν ἀπὸ ἀκανθῶν σταφυλὰς ἢ ἀπὸ τριβόλων σῦκα;

controles.web: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
controles.kjv: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
controles.livre: Vós os conhecereis pelos seus frutos. Por acaso se colhem uvas dos espinheiros, ou figos dos abrolhos?

versos.grego: οὕτως πᾶν δένδρον ἀγαθὸν καρποὺς καλοὺς ποιεῖ, τὸ δὲ σαπρὸν δένδρον καρποὺς πονηροὺς ποιεῖ·

controles.web: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit; but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
controles.kjv: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
controles.livre: Assim toda boa árvore dá bons frutos, mas a arvore má dá frutos maus.

versos.grego: οὐ δύναται δένδρον ἀγαθὸν καρποὺς πονηροὺς ἐνεγκεῖν, οὐδὲ δένδρον σαπρὸν καρποὺς καλοὺς ἐνεγκεῖν.

controles.web: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
controles.kjv: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
controles.livre: A boa árvore não pode dar frutos maus, nem a árvore má dar bons frutos.

versos.grego: πᾶν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

controles.web: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.
controles.kjv: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
controles.livre: Toda árvore que não dá bom fruto é cortada e lançada ao fogo.

versos.grego: ἄραγε ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν αὐτῶν ἐπιγνώσεσθε αὐτούς.

controles.web: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
controles.kjv: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
controles.livre: Portanto vós os conhecereis pelos seus frutos.

versos.grego: Οὐ πᾶς ὁ λέγων μοι Κύριε Κύριε, εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἀλλ’ ὁ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

controles.web: Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
controles.kjv: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
controles.livre: Não é qualquer um que me diz: “Senhor, Senhor” que entrará no Reino dos céus; mas sim aquele que faz a vontade do meu Pai que está nos céus.

versos.grego: πολλοὶ ἐροῦσίν μοι ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ Κύριε Κύριε, οὐ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι ἐπροφητεύσαμεν, καὶ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι δαιμόνια ἐξεβάλομεν, καὶ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι δυνάμεις πολλὰς ἐποιήσαμεν;

controles.web: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’
controles.kjv: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
controles.livre: Muitos me dirão naquele dia: “Senhor, Senhor! Não profetizamos em teu nome? E em teu nome não expulsamos os demônios? E em teu nome não fizemos muitas maravilhas?”

versos.grego: καὶ τότε ὁμολογήσω αὐτοῖς ὅτι Οὐδέποτε ἔγνων ὑμᾶς· ἀποχωρεῖτε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν.

controles.web: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
controles.kjv: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
controles.livre: Então claramente lhes direi: “Nunca vos conheci. Afastai-vos de mim, transgressores!”  )

versos.grego: Πᾶς οὖν ὅστις ἀκούει μου τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ ποιεῖ αὐτούς, ὁμοιωθήσεται ἀνδρὶ φρονίμῳ, ὅστις ᾠκοδόμησεν αὐτοῦ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐπὶ τὴν πέτραν.

controles.web: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house on a rock.
controles.kjv: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
controles.livre: Portanto todo o que ouve estas minhas palavras e as praticaserá comparado ao homem prudente, que construiu sua casa sobre a rocha.

versos.grego: καὶ κατέβη ἡ βροχὴ καὶ ἦλθον οἱ ποταμοὶ καὶ ἔπνευσαν οἱ ἄνεμοι καὶ προσέπεσαν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ οὐκ ἔπεσεν· τεθεμελίωτο γὰρ ἐπὶ τὴν πέτραν.

controles.web: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
controles.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
controles.livre: E a chuva desceu, correntezas vieram, ventos sopraram, e atingiram aquela casa; e ela não caiu, porque estava fundada sobre a rocha.

versos.grego: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀκούων μου τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ μὴ ποιῶν αὐτοὺς ὁμοιωθήσεται ἀνδρὶ μωρῷ, ὅστις ᾠκοδόμησεν αὐτοῦ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐπὶ τὴν ἄμμον.

controles.web: Everyone who hears these words of mine, and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man, who built his house on the sand.
controles.kjv: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
controles.livre: Porém todo o que ouve estas minhas palavras e não as pratica, eu o compararei ao homem tolo, que construiu sua casa sobre a areia.

versos.grego: καὶ κατέβη ἡ βροχὴ καὶ ἦλθον οἱ ποταμοὶ καὶ ἔπνευσαν οἱ ἄνεμοι καὶ προσέκοψαν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ ἔπεσεν, καὶ ἦν ἡ πτῶσις αὐτῆς μεγάλη.

controles.web: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell—and great was its fall.”
controles.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
controles.livre: E a chuva desceu, correntezas vieram, ventos sopraram, e atingiram aquela casa; e ela caiu, e sua queda foi grande.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοὺς λόγους τούτους, ἐξεπλήσσοντο οἱ ὄχλοι ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus terminou estas palavras, as multidões estavam admiradas de sua doutrina,

versos.grego: ἦν γὰρ διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ὡς ἐξουσίαν ἔχων, καὶ οὐχ ὡς οἱ γραμματεῖς αὐτῶν.

controles.web: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
controles.kjv: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
controles.livre: porque ele os ensinava como tendo autoridade, e não como os seus escribas.
